# k0rdent_file_store (Data Source)

One file store, read rather than managed.

Use it to name a store another configuration owns, from a state boundary that holds the things mounting it. `consumer_status` is what to read on that side: it is what the backing storage is actually enforcing rather than what was asked for, so a host can mount once its entry reads `active` and not before.

The desired consumer list is not returned. That belongs to whoever manages the store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a file store another configuration owns, from the configuration whose
# hosts mount it.

variable "consumer_id" {
  description = "The instance group or cluster that mounts the store."
  type        = string
}

data "k0rdent_file_store" "datasets" {
  id = "training-datasets"
}

# Warn until the grant is `active`. Until then hosts can't mount. try()
# gives "" if there's no entry for this consumer yet.
check "consumer_can_mount" {
  assert {
    condition     = try(data.k0rdent_file_store.datasets.consumer_status[var.consumer_id].state, "") == "active"
    error_message = "The grant for ${var.consumer_id} on training-datasets is not enforced yet."
  }
}

output "mount_source" {
  value = "${data.k0rdent_file_store.datasets.preferred_export_location.server}:${data.k0rdent_file_store.datasets.preferred_export_location.path}"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) File store name. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to read. Defaults to the provider's `project`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Read-Only

- `capacity_gib` (Number) Declared capacity, in binary gibibytes. It is what the store is accounted at rather than a hard quota: the storage behind this API does not enforce it, so a store can consume beyond it.
- `consumer_status` (Attributes Map) What the backing storage is enforcing, keyed by consumer `ref`. A superset of the configured consumers while a revocation is in flight.

A `failed` entry whose `state_reason` is `GROUP_MEMBERSHIP_DRIFTED` still covers the machines it was written against, so it is not necessarily an outage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consumer_status))
- `description` (String) Free-form text describing it, for people to read.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name, for display only.
- `export_locations` (Attributes List) Where the store can be mounted from, sorted by `server` and then `path`. To mount, use `preferred_export_location`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--export_locations))
- `preferred_export_location` (Attributes) The location a tenant host should mount: the one the platform marks preferred and not operator-only. Null until the store is active. The mount source is `<server>:<path>`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--preferred_export_location))
- `reconciling` (Boolean) Whether the platform is still bringing the store into line with what was asked for.
- `self_link` (String) Platform-defined reference to this store.
- `share_type` (String) The share type this store was provisioned from.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state. `active` is settled and mountable.
- `state_message` (String) The platform's own explanation of the current state. Read it, do not branch on it.
- `state_reason` (String) Machine-readable cause of the current state, when the platform gives one.

<a id="nestedatt--consumer_status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consumer_status`

Read-Only:

- `resolved_addresses` (Set of String) The addresses this consumer resolved to, which is what answers which machines the grant actually reached. IPv4 only.
- `state` (String) `creating`, `active`, `deleting` or `failed`.
- `state_message` (String) Why this consumer is in this state. Read it, do not branch on it.
- `state_reason` (String) Machine-readable cause, upper-cased. Stable enough to branch on.


<a id="nestedatt--export_locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `export_locations`

Read-Only:

- `admin_only` (Boolean) Whether this location is meant for the operator rather than for tenant hosts.
- `options` (String) Mount options the platform recommends.
- `path` (String) Export path on the server.
- `preferred` (Boolean) Whether this is the location to prefer.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol the export is served over.
- `server` (String) Address of the storage server.


<a id="nestedatt--preferred_export_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `preferred_export_location`

Read-Only:

- `options` (String) Mount options the platform recommends.
- `path` (String) Export path on the server.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol the export is served over.
- `server` (String) Address of the storage server.
